question: Does completed mobile trading loss feedback within the current original industry attempt cover broad initial/add/reentry losses without excluding the strong-window winners?
status: frozen before new feedback classification; exploratory historical research, no unseen claim
definition: At actual decision CLOSE, take all previously fully sold mobile layers in the same sector and original industry probe identity. Sum actual sell.parts net_cash minus full original buy gross and buy fee. Negative iff this completed trading cash sum <0; no observations is a distinct class.
identity: sector + original industry probe_day in saved causal probe_progress; original fixed tails use exact original state attempt at decision and original probe day
clock: Each observation's final actual sell timestamp must be strictly earlier than decision_at. Partial-only realizations, dividend AR, open marks and future terminal labels never enter the feedback.
mothers: strict 303 actual fills opened after 2024-10-08 and through 2024-12-31
all pre-existing original fixed tail cohorts 83 and 94 with unmatched explicit
comparisons: completed mobile trading cash sum negative
completed mobile trading cash sum zero or positive
diagnostics: feedback lag and prior layer/stock counts
observed original net positive and negative contributions including open/unpaid separately
negative group exact matched and unmatched original fixed tails
old attempt completed losses omitted by reset
partial mobile realizations omitted by completion-only definition
decision: One classification only. No windows, thresholds or new alternative chosen after outcomes. If coverage is small or strong winner injury is material, stop before account engineering. A promising association is at most grounds for a separate bounded causal-account experiment.
precedents: Existing budget_v3 already has losses and exhausted-policy modes, current native record_only; this is a completed-net-feedback scope diagnostic, not a claim of a new loss-budget idea.
prohibited: policy return computed by deleting old PnL
